Package index

Redact and replace

Redact sensitive text in vectors, data frames, lists and labels using patterns, column rules and NLP, and set package-wide defaults.

anon()
Redact and replace sensitive information in R objects
more_patterns()
Create expanded pattern vector for text matching
anon_options()
Get or set package options used by anon

Techniques for specific data types

Pseudonymize identifiers and contact details, shift dates, and generalize, shuffle or add noise to numbers while keeping their structure useful.

Identifiers

anon_id_chr_sequence()
Pseudonymize identifiers as sequential character IDs
anon_id_num_sequence()
Pseudonymize identifiers as sequential numeric IDs

Dates

anon_date_shift()
Shift dates to a new time period

Contact details

anon_email()
Replace email addresses with pseudonymous addresses
anon_phone_number()
Replace phone numbers with pseudonymous numbers

Numbers

anon_num_preserve_distribution()
Shuffle, add noise to, or resample numeric values
anon_num_range()
Generalize numeric values into range categories

De-identification

Measure re-identification risk from quasi-identifiers across linked datasets.

anon_risk()
Measure re-identification risk from quasi-identifiers
anon_risk_subjects()
Per-subject re-identification risk
anon_quasi_values()
Specify quasi-identifier values that vary by row

Named entity recognition

Find and redact people, organizations, places, dates and other entities with spaCy, and configure which entity types anon() redacts automatically.

anon_nlp_entities() anon_nlp_proper_nouns() anon_nlp_dates() anon_nlp_dates_and_times() anon_nlp_named() anon_nlp_numbers() anon_nlp_organizations() anon_nlp_people() anon_nlp_places()
Redact Named Entities in Text Using NLP
nlp_get_entities() nlp_get_dates() nlp_get_dates_and_times() nlp_get_named() nlp_get_numbers() nlp_get_organizations() nlp_get_people() nlp_get_places() nlp_get_proper_nouns()
Extract Named Entities from Text
nlp_entity_sets
Named Entity Type Collections
nlp_auto()
Generate NLP auto-redaction options list
nlp_default_replacements()
Generate default replacement options list for NLP entities

Summarize data for sharing

Describe the objects in an environment or list without exposing sensitive values.

anon_inventory()
Build an inventory of objects, applying your redaction rules
anon_data_summary()
Summarize data objects in an environment, applying your redaction rules
anon_example_rows()
Build an example-row specification for anon_data_summary()
anon_report()
Build a report for selected objects, applying your redaction rules

Prepare text and prompts

Import documents, clean and compare text, and assemble redacted context into a prompt bundle.

read_content() read_content_docx() read_content_pptx() read_content_xlsx() read_content_pdf() read_content_text()
Read content from files as text
anon_clean_text()
Clean text for safer prompt input
anon_compare_text()
Compare text before and after cleaning or redaction
anon_prompt_bundle()
Build prompt-ready text from report objects

Export to JSON

as_anon_json()
Serialize anon objects as JSON
as_anon_payload()
Build structured anon payloads

Interactive app

run_anon_app()
Launch the local anon Shiny app

Results and printing

Combine and print the anon_context objects returned by anon() and the summary functions.

c(<anon_context>)
Combine anon_context objects
print(<anon_context>)
Print method for single anon_context objects
print(<anon_context_collection>)
Print method for anon_context_collection
print(<anon_data_summary>)
Print method for environment data summaries
